blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or a second home on a Durieu acreage?
faq.a: Two gates apply. In FVRD Electoral Area F, a secondary suite must be located within the principal dwelling — a separate detached structure such as a garden suite is not the suite route — and if the parcel is in the ALR, an additional detached residence is limited to 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha) on top of one principal residence of at most 500 m²; confirm both the FVRD zoning and the parcel's ALR status for the specific PID before relying on a second-dwelling plan.
